items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: I knew him, dumb man, was a, oh, really beautiful. ... Edward Gasper was playing drums

ctx.x: Oh man, that's a fine boy. That's fine, trombone. I seen Joe died, you heard that? I believe so. I think I heard it, but I heard that afterwards. I knew them boys, I knew, man, that, uh, I knew if they got away from me, mind me being scattered, but they used to, they'd go, they'd come up, we'd be talking, they'd come up to me. Used to, uh, had the Lucian tenor, we used to play there, then we used to play up in the Irish Channel. Yards up in there, man, at lawn parties. Started playing at eight o'clock, and ended…
She said, you all got everything? You got all this stuff? Yeah, we got everything.
